newsitem.title: JAPAN: U.S., Japan share view on currency rates - MOF.
newsitem.headline: U.S., Japan share view on currency rates - MOF.

text.p: Japan and the United States share a common view on foreign exchange rates, Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a parliamentary committee on Monday.
Asked about his meeting with U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin on Saturday, Mitsuzuka said: "We reached a basic understanding at the bilateral meeting, including on the view over exchange rates."
The meeting was held on the sidelines of the weekend meeting of the Group of Seven (G7) industrial nations.

Mitsuzuka also said the understanding with the United States would be effective in tackling an excessively weak or strong yen. He said earlier that Japan's view that an excessively weak or strong yen is unfavourable was accepted by the G7 countries at the weekend.
